title: Split broad Git startup probes after an evidence-free timeout
failure_signature: The first combined worktree, status, head, and branch probe exceeded its bounded shell time and returned no evidence.
trigger_preconditions: combined read-only Git probe returned no evidence
candidate_workaround: Decompose startup Git proof into small read-only probes and capture each native result separately.
recurrence_guard: Do not retry a broad timed-out wrapper or infer any result from its silence.
rollback: Make no repository mutation until the decomposed proof passes.
scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
